_meta.name: Apotrope brand palette
_meta.description: Single source of truth for the Apotrope brand colors. Two layers coexist and are BOTH canonical and INTENTIONALLY different — do not collapse them into one palette.

layers.mark: The watching-eye logo: sacred-geometry linework + ember iris. Used for the mark, key art, app/brand icons, and 'ritual' accents.
layers.product: The CRT/terminal UI: website, HTML report, and terminal. Green-on-near-black hacker terminal with a load-bearing status scale.

rules: Always place the mark on mark.ground (#0B0D0E), the darkest ground. This is the app-icon tile color — NOT a product surface.
The product status scale is load-bearing and must never drift.
The mark palette (soft cyan/mint + warm ember) is deliberately distinct from the vivid product green/cyan. Keeping them separate is correct.

core.role: the watching point — iris (canonical; never recolor)

highlight.role: iris sphere highlight (a lighter shade of core, for the 3D orb)

shade.role: iris sphere shade (a darker shade of core, for the 3D orb)

ground.role: void ground — the mark always sits on this; app-icon/favicon tile color

product._desc: CRT/terminal UI — website, HTML report, terminal.

status._desc: Load-bearing status scale. Must never drift.

surface._desc: Near-black blue-green product backgrounds (#03060A -> #0B1218). Distinct from mark.ground.
